title: FlowR2A: Learning Reward-to-Action Distribution for Multimodal Driving Planning
abstract: arXiv:2606.24231v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multimodal driving planning faces a long-standing tension between two paradigms: scoring-based methods benefit from dense reward supervision but are confined to a fixed action vocabulary, while anchor-based methods generate proposals dynamically yet suffer from sparse supervision constrained to a single ground-truth trajectory. In this work, we propose FlowR2A, which resolves this tension by reframing simulation-based rewards from discriminative targets into generative conditions. By learning the reward-conditioned action distribution from dense trajectory-reward pairs with a flow-matching decoder, FlowR2A unifies the dense supervision of scoring-based methods with the proposal generation of anchor-based methods in a single generative model, forcing the model to internalize the correlation between an action and its outcomes in safety, progress, comfort, and rule compliance. translated_title: FlowR2A：面向多模态驾驶规划的奖励到动作分布学习
translated_abstract: 多模态驾驶规划长期面临两种范式之间的矛盾：基于评分的方法受益于密集的奖励监督，但被限制在固定的动作词表内；而基于锚点的方法能够动态生成候选轨迹，却因只能受单一真值轨迹的稀疏监督而受限。在本工作中，我们提出FlowR2A，通过将基于仿真的奖励从判别式目标重新定义为生成式条件，化解了这一矛盾。FlowR2A利用流匹配解码器，从密集的轨迹-奖励数据对中学习以奖励为条件的动作分布，从而在单一生成模型中统一了基于评分方法的密集监督与基于锚点方法的候选轨迹生成，迫使模型内化动作与其在安全性、行进进度、舒适性以及规则遵循等方面结果之间的关联。为了在硬性安全约束与软性行进目标之间取得平衡……（摘要内容截断于此）
tldr: FlowR2A将基于仿真的奖励从判别式目标重新定义为生成式条件，利用流匹配解码器学习奖励条件下的动作分布，在单一生成模型中统一了密集奖励监督与动态候选轨迹生成，从而提升多模态驾驶规划的效果。
en_tdlr: FlowR2A reframes simulation-based rewards from discriminative targets into generative conditions, learning a reward-conditioned action distribution with a flow-matching decoder to unify dense reward supervision and dynamic proposal generation for multimodal driving planning.
